item.title: Anthropic Reportedly Picks Nasdaq for Potential IPO
item.description: Anthropic has reportedly selected Nasdaq for a potential listing that could value the AI company near $2 trillion, though key terms remain unconfirmed.

item.title: Shanghai AI Lab Releases Intern-S2-Preview-397B for Science
item.description: Shanghai AI Lab introduces Intern-S2-Preview-397B, a 397B multimodal model built for scientific reasoning, long-horizon agents, and research workflows.

item.title: NVIDIA Open-Sources OSMO for Physical AI Workflows
item.description: NVIDIA releases OSMO, a YAML-driven orchestrator linking robot data, simulation, training, and hardware testing across mixed compute.

item.title: ⚡ 15 quick hits — Morning edition, Sep 14
item.description: · Tripo launched a Tripo–Astra challenge for turning a character reference into a rigged, animated 3D asset.（X / Tripo） · Dreamina shared a Seedance 2.5 short video built around an Italian-mafia-family perspective.（X / Dreamina） · Meshy announced a free webinar on AI-assisted environment and prop workflows connecting Meshy with Unreal Engine.（X / Meshy） · Recraft published a side-by-side comparison of GPT Image 2.5 Flare and Recraft V4.1 Pro across several image-generation prompts.（X / Recraft） · QuantaMind’s molecular-structure research was published in Science Advances, using AI to model molecular dynamics as cinematic trajectories.（量子位） · A Chinese financial-AI company reportedly raised more than 300 million yuan in a Series B after completing three rounds in one year.（量子位） · MiniMax said its open-weight H3 model targets video generation with native stereo audio and multimodal reference control.（X / MiniMax） · QbitAI reported that MetaRSI explores AI systems improving the methods used to improve themselves, describing a possible recursive-self-improvement loop.（量子位） · Luma described generative media in entertainment as infrastructure rather than a collection of standalone creator tools.（X / Luma AI） · Simon Willison released commit-rewriter 0.1, a small tool for rewriting Git commits with AI-assisted development workflows.（Simon Willison） · OpenAI said Perplexity uses GPT-6 Astra to write communications, modify software, and monitor production systems with fewer check-ins.（OpenAI） · AWS Developers promoted a $10,000 competition for building an AI agent that handles everyday tasks, with submissions closing the next day.（X / AWS Developers） · Cohere CEO Aidan Gomez argued that AI rules should rely on evidenced standards rather than a cartel of companies.（X / Cohere） · Fireworks AI said it would continue its Alibaba Cloud partnership by bringing the latest Qwen flagship model to its platform.（X / Fireworks AI） · Artificial Analysis said it signed an MOU to support South Korea’s Sovereign AI Model Foundation project as an evaluation partner.（X / Artificial Analysis）

item.title: ⚡ 15 quick hits — Evening edition, Sep 13
item.description: · Microsoft said it will integrate xAI’s Grok models into Word, Excel, and PowerPoint, giving Office users an alternative to OpenAI models.（IT之家） · Zurich Airport said it is deploying two WeRide L4 autonomous electric shuttles initially to transport airport employees.（Zurich Airport） · Fable 5.1 reportedly solved the 370-year-old Cyphral Distich cipher in an automated cryptanalysis demonstration.（Vals AI） · Researchers described a hierarchical NeRF system using JAX3D for volumetric rendering, novel-view synthesis, and 3D reconstruction.（MarkTechPost） · Figma announced a new episode featuring designer and creative technologist Aitana Picó in its Source Material series.（X @figma） · GitHub posted a programmer-focused update encouraging developers to use the platform for coding work and collaboration.（X @github） · A Princeton researcher proposed a recurrent looped transformer that carries decoder state across tokens instead of using a fixed stack of blocks.（MarkTechPost） · A Princeton researcher proposed recurrent looping as a way to provide effectively unbounded temporal depth while reusing decoder parameters.（MarkTechPost） · Supio said its long-horizon legal agents can execute complex case workflows across systems and communication channels.（SiliconANGLE） · Cohere promoted an AI-art performance titled Convergence at Berlin Art Week featuring musicians Actress and Sega Bodega.（X @cohere） · Astra and Fable were reported to remain vulnerable to simple variants of alignment evaluations introduced in 2025.（LessWrong） · A GitHub project called CUDA for AMD on Windows appeared as a community effort to make CUDA-oriented workloads more accessible on AMD hardware.（GitHub） · Databricks promoted an SSH tunnel that lets developers use VS Code, Cursor, or terminals while running code on Databricks compute.（X @databricks） · ElevenLabs made its Music v2.5 model available through its app and API with free and paid tiers.（The Decoder） · Lovart showcased GPT-Image 2.5 arranging flowers from a natural-language instruction.（X @lovart_ai）
